problems.problem: Missing paramagnetic classification; diamagnetic susceptibility is negative (χ < 0), not zero.
problems.correction: diamagnetic (χ < 0, small), paramagnetic (χ > 0, small), and ferromagnetic
problems.verifierReason: Original omits paramagnetism and incorrectly states diamagnetic susceptibility as zero; correction accurately lists three classes with correct susceptibility signs.

problems.quote: the time t = –|r₀|/|v| must be positive
problems.problem: Sign error in collision time formula: if r₀ is anti-parallel to v, the collision time is t = |r₀|/|v|, not –|r₀|/|v|.
problems.correction: the time t = |r₀|/|v| must be positive
problems.verifierReason: Original formula gives negative time; correction yields positive collision time for anti-parallel vectors.

problems.quote: The tangent slope equals each component's chemical potential; the intercepts give the phase molar Gibbs energies.
problems.problem: The tangent slope is the difference in chemical potentials (μ₁−μ₂), not each component's chemical potential; the intercepts give the chemical potentials μ₁ and μ₂, not the phase molar Gibbs energies.
problems.correction: The tangent slope equals the difference in chemical potentials (μ₁−μ₂); the intercepts give the chemical potentials μ₁ and μ₂.
problems.verifierReason: Original misstates tangent slope and intercepts; correction correctly gives slope = μ1-μ2, intercepts = μ1, μ2.
